description: This PHP class defines a model for representing leave comments within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin API. It uses traits for serialization, specifies constructor logic for setting up entity data and API schema information, and references the LeaveComment entity for data mapping.

classes.name: LeaveCommentModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing LeaveComment entities into API responses, including related employee and leave data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LeaveCommentModel with data from a LeaveComment entity, setting filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
